How a live stream can bring your club sponsors

24 November 2026 · Kadar

The bakery across the road will not pay for a banner nobody photographs. It may well pay to be in the picture every time your club plays, in front of parents, former players and people from the town who could not come. A stream gives a small club something to sell that it did not have before.

Where a sponsor can appear

  • By the scoreboard. A logo or a line of text that stays on screen for the whole match.
  • A pop-up. A plate with the sponsor's logo and a line of text that rises into a free corner, stays a few seconds and leaves. In Kadar it can return every 2, 5 or 10 minutes, and several sponsors take turns.
  • The ticker. A sliding line along the bottom: opening hours, an offer for the weekend, the next home match.
  • The half-time slide. The whole picture for the break, when viewers are still there and nothing is happening on the pitch.
  • A prize draw. The sponsor gives the prize, the names spin on screen and the winner is announced live. People stay for it.

What to offer, in plain words

Local businesses do not buy "impressions". They buy something they can picture. Offer packages they understand at once:

  • Match sponsor: the name by the scoreboard and on the half-time slide for one match.
  • Season partner: a pop-up in every home match and a line in the ticker.
  • Prize partner: one prize draw a month with their product.

Set the prices by what your town can bear, and start low for the first sponsor. One satisfied bakery brings the next two businesses.

Show them it worked

After the match, send the sponsor three things: the link to the recording, a screenshot with their logo in the picture, and the number of views. It takes five minutes and it is the reason they renew.

Keep it watchable

Viewers came for the match. A sponsor plate that never covers the score, a ticker that is short, and one prize draw are welcome. A picture buried in logos is not, and it does the sponsor no good either.

Sponsor logos, pop-ups, the ticker and the half-time slide are part of PRO in Kadar. Until 28 February 2027 everything in PRO is free, so a club can sign its first sponsors before it pays for anything.
